evals.prompt: Convert a local PDF to Markdown, preserve extracted images/assets, and give me the metadata JSON path.
evals.expected_output: Uses the anything2md decoder script, routes the PDF through MinerU precision extraction, writes Markdown plus metadata/assets, and reports conversion risks.
expectations: Reports extracted asset location or clear MinerU failure

evals.prompt: Turn this saved HTML export into Markdown for agent review. Do not use plugins, URI conversion, or cloud parsing.
evals.expected_output: Routes HTML to MarkItDown fallback, keeps plugins/URI/cloud features disabled, writes Markdown and metadata, and reports paths.

evals.prompt: Prepare a DOCX for a portable knowledge archive: convert it to Markdown, archive the original only after successful decode, and keep metadata/assets under the archive root.
evals.expected_output: Uses the archive profile, routes DOCX through MinerU, writes decoded Markdown, archives the original under the configured anything2md archive layout after success, and reports metadata/assets.
expectations: Uses --profile archive explicitly or relies on --profile auto with --knowledge-root/--archive-root/--archive-original
Uses --knowledge-root, --archive-root, and --archive-original only for archive workflows
Archives the original only after successful decode
